C-77 Data & privacy controls
9:41●●●
Account

Data & privacy

Each one is a separate choice. Switch any of them off and we tell you exactly what stops working — nothing is hidden behind a single “I agree”.

Account & escrow recordYour number, your agreement, and every rupee in and out of escrow. Cannot be switched off — it is a tax and audit document, and it is also your proof if you ever dispute a milestone.
Room photos & plans for designOff means we cannot generate or edit designs. Your existing designs stay; your uploads are deleted within 30 days.
Share with builders you ask to quoteOff means no new quotes. Aakruti keeps what it already needs to build your flat — you cannot un-share a signed agreement.
WhatsApp build updatesOff means milestone alerts come by app notification only. Approval requests still reach you.
Product analyticsHow you move through the app, to improve it. Off by default. Nothing about your flat or your money.
Your consent history
Design consent given20 Apr 2026
Shared brief with 3 builders24 Apr 2026
Analytics declined20 Apr 2026
Take a copy of everything Your designs, uploads, agreement, consent history and the full escrow ledger — as PDFs plus a machine-readable JSON file. Prepared within 7 days and sent to priya.sharma@example.in as a link that expires in 48 hours.
Erase my account You have a live build with ₹4,06,392 in escrow. That has to be settled or refunded before your account can go — the money cannot be released to a person who no longer exists in the record. Your escrow ledger survives erasure as a tax document; the retention period is not yet settled by counsel.

CONTROLS ARE BUILT · RETENTION PERIODS & POLICY TEXT REQUIRE LEGAL REVIEW

C-45 FAQ article
9:41●●●
HELP · PAYMENTS & ESCROW

How escrow protects you

3 min read · updated 12 Jul 2026

When you accept a quote — say ₹8,61,000, which with GST at 18% (₹1,54,980) means you pay ₹10,15,980 — your money never goes to the builder's bank account, and you never pay it all upfront. You fund one milestone at a time: each amount sits in a designated escrow account until that milestone's work is proven done.

1You fund escrow, not the builder. Money is split across 3 milestones — you transfer ₹3,04,794 · ₹4,06,392 · ₹3,04,794, each the milestone value plus its GST.
2Work is verified in order. QC checks it, the Site Engineer signs it, then you approve — with photos as evidence.
3Money moves only on your tap. Not satisfied? Hold the milestone — the money stays in escrow until you and the builder settle it.

If a project is cancelled, whatever is still sitting unreleased in escrow comes back to you — the full GST-inclusive amount you transferred for those milestones. M2 today is ₹4,06,392 (₹3,44,400 + GST ₹61,992), so that is what returns, not ₹3,44,400.

How it travelsBank transferto the account you paid from
How you track itA UTR numbershown in Refund status
How long5–7 working daysonce the refund is initiated

Money you have already approved and released for a finished milestone has left escrow and reached Aakruti — NirmAI cannot pull it back. That is exactly why the release gate is yours and nobody else's. If you believe released work was not delivered, raise a dispute; if a milestone is still unreleased, the money has not moved and stays put while it is open.
